question: Estimate the annual ad revenue of YouTube from India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Indian advertisers' spend on YouTube ads? Yes.
Excludes YouTube Premium revenue? Yes — only ads.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian digital ad market × YouTube share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian digital ad spend FY26: ~₹65,000-70,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: YouTube share of video ads: ~70% = ~₹12,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹12,000-13,000 Cr YouTube India ad revenue.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Estimate covers AdSense paid to creators + Google's gross share.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of this, video ads (long-form + Shorts + display)

calculationFlow: Indian digital ad spend FY26: ~₹65,000-70,000 Cr.
Of this, video ads (long-form + Shorts + display): ~25% = ~₹17,000 Cr.
YouTube share of video ads: ~70% = ~₹12,000 Cr.
Plus Search/display + Shopping (Google ecosystem): allocated separately.
Round: ~₹12,000-13,000 Cr YouTube India ad revenue.
Estimate covers AdSense paid to creators + Google's gross share.
